Name: Technical contract work template - default form

$values.Content:
1. Daily: check contracts where the deadline has arrived for preparing a renewal addendum.

If the renewal process has not yet been started for such a contract, start the process.
$values.DisplayName:
1. Daily: check contracts where the deadline has arrived for preparing a renewal addendum.

If the renewal process has not yet been started for such a contract, start the process.

$values.Content:
2. Daily: check contracts where the renewal process has started (supplementary agreement created) and the deadline has arrived for the previous terms to expire (current term "Valid Until").

If the renewal supplementary agreement for such a contract has status "Signed", then update the contract terms from the supplementary agreement (Rate and new "Valid Until" date), and set contract status to "Effective".

If the supplementary agreement was not approved and signed in time (any status other than "Signed"), set the contract status to "Not effective". Do not update the contract terms.
$values.DisplayName:
2. Daily: check contracts where the renewal process has started (supplementary agreement created) and the deadline has arrived for the previous terms to expire (current term "Valid Until").

If the renewal supplementary agreement for such a contract has status "Signed", then update the contract terms from the supplementary agreement (Rate and new "Valid Until" date), and set contract status to "Effective".

If the supplementary agreement was not approved and signed in time (any status other than "Signed"), set the contract status to "Not effective". Do not update the contract terms.

Label.Text: Update renewal conditions and statuses for contracts:

$values.Content: 3. Daily: check issued but unpaid invoices. If the "Due date" is earlier than or equal to today (already past), update the invoice status to "Overdue"
$values.DisplayName: 3. Daily: check issued but unpaid invoices. If the "Due date" is earlier than or equal to today (already past), update the invoice status to "Overdue"

Label.Text: List of invoices to update status to Overdue

$values.Content: 4. Daily: check issued and unpaid Invoices. If the payment deadline is approaching, send a reminder to the tenant about the unpaid invoice.
$values.DisplayName: 4. Daily: check issued and unpaid Invoices. If the payment deadline is approaching, send a reminder to the tenant about the unpaid invoice.

Label.Text: Send reminder for the following invoices:

$values.Content:
5. Check active lease contracts (status: "Effective"). If the monthly rent invoice has not been issued for the contract, automatically generate the current month's rent invoice.

By default, rent invoices are issued at the beginning of each month (on the 1st or the first business day).

Reconfiguration for invoicing on other dates and terms specified in the contract is possible as a customization project upon request.
$values.DisplayName:
5. Check active lease contracts (status: "Effective"). If the monthly rent invoice has not been issued for the contract, automatically generate the current month's rent invoice.

$values.Content:
6. Check active lease contracts (status: "Effective") where the utility payment option is set to "Separate invoice". If no utility invoice has been issued for the period, automatically generate one.

By default, utility invoices are issued on the 15th of each month (or the next business day). The invoice covers the previous month (e.g., February 15 for January).

Reconfiguration for invoicing on other dates and terms specified in the contract is possible as a customization project upon request.
